summary.text: Lisa Gourley is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 66, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Brian Smith.
A retired registered nurse, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she supports public education, abortion rights and a higher minimum wage.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Gourley earned a high school diploma from Punxsutawney Area High School and an associate degree from Mount Aloysius College in 1994, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her career experience as working as a registered nurse.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a retired registered nurse who worked for 30 years and entered the race to give voice to district residents who disagree with the current representative's votes.
Gourley named supporting public education over voucher programs, protecting the right of women to make their own medical decisions, and raising Pennsylvania's minimum wage as her key messages.
She listed health care, public education and a living wage as policy interests, and named PSEA-PAC, UAW and Healthcare for All PA among her endorsers.
